items.title: While there are no official injury reports in the preseason, #Spurs say other than Tobias Harris (calf strain), Maliq Brown (back tightness) and Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery rehab), everyone is good to go for tonight’s exhibition opener against Atlanta.
